## New since this prompt was drafted: the return LM8_LIE_APPROXIMATIONS (added 13 November 2026)

The prompt LM8_LIE_APPROXIMATIONS of this series (§§52–53 of La Longue Marche) was answered by GPT-6 Astra (ChatGPT Pro mode); the run stopped on 13 November 2026 and its last checkpoint is marked INCOMPLETE (167 statements: 122 proved, 15 known, 24 refuted, 6 open). It has not been reviewed. An intake by Claude Fable 5.2 (effort high) read the two statements below with their proofs and found no error. They are attached as `LM8_return/sections/E.tex` (conventions in `LM8_return/sections/00_conventions.tex`), with the results register `LM8_return/LM8_LIE_APPROXIMATIONS_results.csv`; cite them as LM8 E.10 and LM8 E.11. Read both proofs first, confirm each step with your own argument or give the exact error with a repair, and report any error; then use them.

- **LM8 E.10.** For chart discs `D_n` shrinking to a point `p` of a surface and `D_n^* = D_n ∖ {p}`, the filtered 2-colimit of the categories of coverings `Cov(D_n^*)` is the category of `Z`-sets; its finite part is the category of finite continuous `Ẑ`-sets. A non-zero tangent ray at `p` gives a fibre functor, and the groupoid of these fibre functors with path transport is the fundamental groupoid of the circle of rays. Near a smooth divisor the same holds in coordinates `Δ^{d−1} × Δ^*`; near a point of a divisor with normal crossings with `r` branches, `Z^r` replaces `Z`.
- **LM8 E.11.** The inverse 2-limit of the full sheaf topoi `Sh(D_n^*)` along the open inclusions is the degenerate topos. For a cone `f_n: ℰ → Sh(D_n^*)`, the annuli `U_k = {1/k < |z| < 1}` cover `D_1^*`; each `f_1^*(U_k)` is the initial object, because `U_k ∩ D_k^* = ∅` and `f_1` factors through `Sh(D_k^*)`; and inverse images preserve unions. So the topos of the germ of a punctured disc is not this limit. The object that carries the coverings is the classifying topos `BZ` of E.10; the neighbourhood data are kept by the pro-topos `(Sh(D_n^*))_n`.

What this changes here.

- Part F (d) asks to define the topos of a germ of neighbourhoods `𝒱_{D′,Y}` and of its punctured part. By LM8 E.11 the punctured part is not the limit, in the 2-category of topoi, of the sheaf topoi of the punctured neighbourhoods: that limit is degenerate already for one point on a curve.
